native_mechanisms: Eight strings bound under one bridge over the counting-bars: a pluck on any one string shivers into all the others — a wide coupled multi-lane mixing engine applied to every mark.
A fresh, never-repeated ink-weight (feather) per mark, folded in by weight not shape — a per-block unique running counter that fixes strict ordering into the state.

The storm's single hands-off pass over the final tremor, collapsing it to eight small notes, with the pickers destroying every discarded feather and drop — an O(1) finalization plus truncation/discard of the rest of the state.
core_technique: Sponge-style absorption of 64-byte blocks into a 512-bit eight-lane state via one cross-coupled ARX (Feistel-like add/rotate/xor + lane re-pairing) round per block with a per-block counter, then 16 fixed finalization rounds and a per-lane bit-fold to one byte each for the 64-bit output; only the len<64 path falls back to FNV/xxHash-style multiply-xor-shift on a single accumulator.
